locator.text: Display 35.7, p. 35, in the statement of Lemma 4.8

evidence: paper: U_{\mathrm{o}} = M_{\mathrm{o}} = J_{\mathrm{o}} = 0 \quad (X \ge X_{\mathrm{v}}), \\ M_{\mathrm{o}}(\infty) = J_{\mathrm{o}}(\infty) = S_{\mathrm{o}}(\infty) = 0, \qquad \int_0^{\infty} (H_{\mathrm{o}} - H_{\mathrm{pow}})\, dX = 0,

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Clause by clause the statements agree; the rewriting is only between a limit at infinity and an improper integral. (a) U_o = M_o = J_o = 0 for X ≥ X_v is `after_pulse` verbatim, with X_v = OutgoingDilation.pulseEndRadius F XR = X_R·exp(endpoint); Lean states it for every real η, the paper for |η| ≤ 1. (b) M_o(∞) = J_o(∞) = 0 are `mass_zero` and `angular_zero`, written as ∫ over Ioi 0 rather than lim_{X→∞} ∫_{Ioc 0 X}; the two agree because the corresponding …_integrable fields are part of the same structure (and in fact M_o, J_o are already identically 0 beyond X_v by (a)). (c) S_o(∞) = 0 is `energy_zero`, totalS = ∫_{Ioi 0}(U² − E²/2), matching S of (4.15) in the same limit sense. (d) ∫_0^∞ (H_o − H_pow) dX = 0 is `renormalized_zero`, with H = √(2X)E and powerH = √(2X)·powerConstant·(X/X_R)^{−(1/2+h)}, i.e. c_∞ X^{−A} for A = 1/2 + h (the paper's A, text p. 7). The η-range of `energy_zero` and `renormalized_zero` is `energyDomain F`, which contains [−1,1] by the structure's own `neighborhood_contains` field (HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain = Icc (−1) 1), so the paper's range is covered.
